theory.title: Pide en una cafetería o restaurante
theory.explanation: En esta misión vas a mantener un intercambio sencillo con el personal. Para pedir con educación, usa “Could I have…?” o “I'd like…”. Para pedir algo concreto, añade el nombre del plato o la bebida y termina con “please”. El personal puede preguntar “Would you like anything else?”; puedes responder “No, thank you. That's all.” Para terminar, pide la cuenta y pregunta si puedes pagar con tarjeta.
theory.tip: “Could I have…?” es una petición educada, no una pregunta sobre capacidad. “I'd like…” significa “Quisiera…”. En inglés británico, “bill” es la cuenta; “chips” suele referirse a patatas fritas gruesas.

content.passage: Liam and Sara arrive at a small café at one o'clock. The café is busy, but a table is available. The server shows them the menu. Sara asks for the soup of the day, and Liam orders a cheese sandwich. They both have still water. The server asks, “Would you like anything else?” Sara says, “No, thank you. That's all.” After lunch, Liam asks for the bill. He pays by card. They thank the server and leave the café.

content.audioTranscript: Good afternoon. Do you have a reservation? No, we don't. A table for two, please. Of course. Here is the menu. Thank you. Could I have the soup, please? Certainly. And I'd like a cheese sandwich. Would you like anything to drink? Still water, please. Would you like anything else? No, thank you. That's all. Here is your bill. Can I pay by card? Yes, of course. Would you like to pay in cash? No, thank you. Have a lovely day.
